title: Marcus Aurelius' Meditations: The Stoic Ideal
summary: Michael Sugrue's lecture on Marcus Aurelius' Meditations and the Stoic ideal, covering the text and its philosophy. It is one of his humanities lectures known for their clarity.
why: HN recommends it as a classic, clear introduction to Aurelius, with some saying it helped through hard times.

quote.text: have watched this lecture multiple times (each time I was going through some bad things in my life) and it helped me tremendously.
